# BuyTest

> BuyTest is a Hebrew-language vehicle information and used-car report explanation service operated by Amos Rokach.

## About
BuyTest helps prospective used-car buyers review available vehicle information, prepare questions before a vehicle inspection, and understand text from an inspection report. It does not physically inspect vehicles, certify safety, estimate repair costs or recommend whether to buy a vehicle.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://buytest.co.il/): Vehicle information and BuyTest services.
- [About](https://buytest.co.il/about/): About BuyTest and Amos Rokach.
- [Contact](https://buytest.co.il/contact/): Contact by email or WhatsApp.
- [Articles](https://buytest.co.il/articles/): Used-car buying and inspection guides.
- [Terms of use](https://buytest.co.il/terms/): Service terms and limitations.
- [Privacy policy](https://buytest.co.il/privacy/): Data handling and privacy information.

## Content guidance
BuyTest explanations are based on user-provided vehicle data and inspection-report text. They are informational and should be checked against the original documents and qualified professionals. The service is not affiliated with inspection institutes.
